headline: Baazar Style Retail Limited: Final Monitoring Agency Report on IPO Proceeds Utilisation (Q1 FY2027)
sum: Baazar Style Retail Limited files its final Monitoring Agency (MA) report for Q1 FY2027 (ended 30 June 2026), marking closure of IPO proceeds tracking. The report concludes the mandatory monitoring regime under SEBI IPO guidelines and represents full deployment or completion of fundraising deployment milestones.
implication: The final MA report signals completion of the IPO lifecycle monitoring phase; post-closure, the company transitions to routine disclosure and auditor certification regimes under the Companies Act and listing rules, but loss of the external MA gating function may increase auditor reliance on schedule of utilisation accuracy.
detail: Baazar Style Retail Limited (STYLEBAAZA) raised capital via IPO and deployed proceeds under SEBI monitoring. The Q1 FY2027 (ended 30 June 2026) Monitoring Agency Report is explicitly marked as the 'last' MA report, indicating that all IPO proceeds have been substantially deployed or the deployment window has closed. Under SEBI ICDR Regulations, companies must file MA reports quarterly until proceeds are fully utilised or a defined wind-down period expires; this report's finality confirms the company has met those deployment milestones and transitions to post-IPO continuous disclosure and annual auditor certification of utilisation schedules.
